title: Private Back-Country Distillery, Brewery, or Pub Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The perfect sanctuary for men to escape the toils of daily life, fill their gullets with fine crafted spirits and brews, and beat their chests in harmonious praise and triumph of a day’s hunting well done! Embark on a meticulously curated journey spanning 7 hours, traversing through the rugged beauty of the Willamette Valley while experiencing some of the most badass distilleries and breweries in the region. And fear not, for this invitation extends to sassy or wild women alike!

These are not pearl district hipster lounges, but rather, some of the most unique destinations to grab a beer or whiskey in the Willamette Valley; artisans that are off the beaten path, have small batch mentalities, or farm the ingredients that go directly into their craft. Your adventure awaits with a trifecta of brewery or distillery visits, curated to your desired experience, and transportation in one of our spacious and upfitted vehicles. Take a photo/video tour of our fleet online and book your adventure!
